{{Top|leg|title=''Vor'cha'' stun stick}}
The '''''Vor'cha'' stun stick''' was a weapon used by the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] monks. It resembled a wooden stick wrapped in silvery wire and delivered a powerful energy charge that could render a victim unconscious. The Vor'cha were able to penetrate armor and electrocute a victim regardless of what they were wearing. [[Ben Skywalker]] reasoned that it was very powerful as it was designed by 'rock guys' to fell their enemies.
